description: This file defines a function 'additionalDetailsCampaign' that generates an HTML snippet with campaign details for display, based on input fields. It appears to be part of a CRM system, specifically SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, providing additional details for Campaign records in the UI.

methods.name: additionalDetailsCampaign
methods.description: Generates an array containing a formatted string of campaign details, including start date, tracker text, URL, objective, and content, each truncated to 300 characters if necessary. Also returns links for editing and viewing the campaign record.
